collectible.title: Priscilla's hair ornament
collectible.subtitle: A small fraction of her beauty.
collectible.text: Priscilla gave this ornament to you, saying: "You can have this, peasant. Maybe then your attire won't be so painfully pedestrian." She seemed to like the way it looked on you.
collectible.unlock: Play a game against Priscilla Barielle to its full conclusion.
